result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, patient-centred framing with absolute, first-person plural commitments such as 'every day' and 'every decision'. Patients lead, and innovation is the headline theme. Employee culture and inclusion appear through the four values. Shareholders are absent. Awards and sales figures are factual business description. Environment and safety are not addressed.
